description: Bump the pins on shane/workflows from the forge's own tags

packageRules.description: The pins on shane/workflows move as soon as a tag exists. The tags are made on purpose by the release steps in AGENTS.md, so the release age wait and the Sunday batch guard nothing here.
The custom manager reads shane/workflows from the forge's tags. github-actions would look the short form up on github.com, where shane is someone else.
actions/checkout v5 and later keep the job's credentials where git on the host runner can't read them, so fetching from the forge fails
